docs.title: 镜头​组装
docs.text: ​镜头​组装​是​生产流程​的​重要环节​， ​主要​是​针对​从​动画​环节​到​后面​的​灯光​、​解算​、​特效​相关​的​自动​生成​、​自动更新​等​。

docs.title: 概述
docs.text:
「​本​机​控制​通道​」​是​程序​开​的​一个​ ​只​监听​本​机​ ​的​小​服务​：​外部​脚本​（​命令行​、​另​一段​ Python、 ​自动化​工具​）​可以​通过​它​读取​程序​里​的​状态​、​截图​，​在​明确​允许​的​情况​下​还​能​执行​代码​、​操作界面​。

​它​主要​服务​于​两种​场景​：

  • ​现场​排障​：​某个​问题​只​在​特定​机器​上​复现​时​，​技术支持​可以​直接​读取​程序​里​的​真实​状态​， ​不用​反复​让​人​截图​、​导​日志​
  • ​批量​与​自动化​：​对​多台​机器​做​同样​的​操作​，​或者​把​程序​接到​已有​的​自动化​流程​里​

​默认​不​开启​，​且​只​对​管理员​显示​

​通道​默认​是​关闭​的​，​每次​运行​程序​都​需要​手动​打开​；​菜单​入口​只​对​ ​管理员​及​以上​权限​ ​的​账户​显示​ （​账户​权限​见​流程​管理​ - ​账户​权限​）。

docs.title: 打开​与​关闭
docs.text:
​打开​ ​工具​ → ​本​机​控制​通道​：

​菜单项​ ​说明​ ​启用​ ​勾选​即​开启​，​取消​即​关闭​；​勾选​状态​与​实际​状态​一致​ ​允许​执行​代码​（exec） ​默认​关闭​。​开启​后​可以​远程​执行​任意​代码​；​改完​需要​关闭​通道​再​重新​启用​才​会​生效​ ​显示​连接​信息​… ​显示​地址​、​令牌​、​当前​状态​、​配置文件​与​审计​日志​路径​，​文字​可以​选中​复制

docs.title: 状态栏​提示
docs.text:
​通道​开启​后​，​状态栏​右侧​会​出现​一块​提示牌​，​提醒​当前​它​正开着​：

​状态​ ​显示​ ​已​开启​ ​琥珀色​ ● ​桥接​已​开启​ ​已​开启​，​并且​允许​执行​代码​ ​红色​ ● ​桥接​已​开启​ · ​可​执行​代码​

​提示牌​就​在​「​管理员​」​标签​的​右边​，​点击​即可​查看​连接​信息​：

​它​每​ 3 ​秒​与​通道​的​实际​状态​核对​一次​：​通道​被​关闭​或​异常​退出​时会​自己​消失​；​通道​没​开时​不会​显示​， ​所以​状态栏​不会​出现​「​显示​着​开着​、​实际​已经​关​了​」​的​情况​。

docs.title: 连接​信息
docs.text:
​点击​「​显示​连接​信息​…」​可以​看到​当前​地址​、​令牌​，​以及​两个​文件​的​位置​：

​内容​ ​位置​ ​配置文件​（​令牌​、​端口​、​开关​状态​） %APPDATA%\XpApps\bridge.json ​审计​日志​ ​临时​目录​下​的​ bridge_audit.log（「​显示​连接​信息​…」​里​有​完整​路径​）

​外部​调用​示例​（​一行​一个​ JSON，\n ​分帧​）：

import json
import socket


def call(action, payload=None, port=8765, token="<​显示​连接​信息​…​里​的​令牌​>"):
    with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=20) as s:
        req = {"id": 1, "action": action, "payload": payload or {}, "token": token}
        s.sendall((json.dumps(req, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))
        buf = b""
        while not buf.endswith(b"\n"):      # ​截图​这​类​回复​比较​大​，​要读​到​换行​为止​
            chunk = s.recv(65536)
            if not chunk:
                break
            buf += chunk
    return json.loads(buf.decode("utf-8"))


print(call("status"))                       # ​窗口​标题​ / ​尺寸​ / ​是否​可见​
print(call("screenshot"))                   # ​主​窗口​截图​（base64 PNG）
print(call("exec", {"code": "result = 1 + 1"}))
​动作​ ​参数​ ​说明​ ping — ​返回​ pong，​用来​确认​通道​是否​正常​ status — ​窗口​标题​、​尺寸​、​是否​可见​、​是否​最小化​ screenshot — ​主​窗口​截图​（base64 PNG） exec {"code": "..."} ​执行​一段​ Python，​返回​输出​；​需要​先​允许​执行​代码​ click {"name": "​控件​名​"} ​按​控件​名​点击​ set_text {"name": "...", "text": "..."} ​设置​控件​文本

docs.title: 安全​说明
docs.text:
• ​只​绑定​本​机​回环​地址​ 127.0.0.1，​其他​机器​连不上​；​但​同一​台​机器​上​的​其它​程序​可以​连​
  • ​令牌​在​第一次​开启​时​随机​生成​，​保存​在​用户​目录​（%APPDATA%\XpApps\bridge.json）， ​只有​当前​用户​读​得到​；​令牌​不​对​的​请求​会​被​直接​拒绝​
  • 「​允许​执行​代码​（exec）」​等价​于​把​程序​能​做​的​事​都​交出去​，​只​在​需要​时​打开​，​用​完请​关掉​， ​不要​长期​开着​
  • ​每次​调用​都​会​在​审计​日志​里​留​一条​记录​（​时间​、​动作​、​是否​成功​、​执行​代码​的​前​ 120 ​个字符​）
  • ​通道​的​菜单​入口​只​对​管理员​显示​，​普通​制作人员​看不到​
  • ​不​需要​这个​功能​时​，​可以​让​发布​版本​完全​不​加载​它​

docs.title: 常见问题
docs.text:
​提示​「Bridge ​启动​失败​（​端口​ 8765 ​可能​被​占用​）」

​说明​端口​被​其它​程序​占用​了​。​可以​换​一个​端口​，​或者​关掉​占用​端口​的​程序​后​重试​。

​关掉​程序​以后​通道​还​在​吗​？

​不​在​。​程序​退出​通道​就​结束​了​，​下次​运行​程序​需要​重新​手动​开启​。

​想换​一个​令牌​怎么办​？

​删除​配置文件​ %APPDATA%\XpApps\bridge.json，​重新​启用​通道​时会​生成​新​的​令牌​。

​为什么​我​看不到​「​本​机​控制​通道​」​这个​菜单​？

​这个​入口​只​对​管理员​及​以上​权限​显示​，​普通​账户​看不到​。​相关​权限​说明​见​ ​流程​管理​ - ​账户​权限​。

docs.title: 自定义​单元格​输入
docs.text: ​主视图​的​自定义​列​可以​按​数据类型​使用​不同​的​输入​控件​。​同时​选中​多行​时​，​还​可以​把​同一​列​一次​改成​ ​相同​的​值​。

docs.title: 多行​同时​输入
docs.text:
1. ​按住​ Ctrl ​或​ Shift ​选择​多行​。
  2. ​当前​单元格​右侧​会​出现​ ... ​提示​。
  3. ​点击​ ...，​菜单​会​显示​已​选择​的​行数​。
  4. ​选择​「​批量​输入​当​前列​...」，​输入​或​选择​新值​。
  5. ​提交​后​，​所有​已​选中​的​可​编辑​行都会​更新​为​同一个​值​。

Tip

... ​只​出现​在​当前​单元格​，​点击​它​不会​取消​其它​已选行​。​未​选中​的​行​不会​修改​。

docs.title: 不同​数据类型​的​控件
docs.text:
data_type ​输入​控件​ ​结果​值​ list ​下​拉​选择​框​，​数据源​为​ value_list ​字符串​ float / double ​浮点数​输入框​ ​浮点数​ int / integer ​整数​输入框​ ​整数​ datetime ​日期​时间​输入框​和​日历​弹窗​ yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss date ​日期​输入框​和​日历​弹窗​ yyyy-MM-dd time ​时间​输入框​ HH:mm:ss ​其它​或​未​配置​ ​原有​ itemDelegate ​保持​原​行为​

​列​显示​、​隐藏​、​列​标识​和​ Python ​计算​列​的​整体​配置​见​ ​表头​列​配置​。

docs.title: 单元格​显示方式​ render_type
docs.text:
data_type ​决定​双击​后​使用​什么​输入​控件​，render_type ​决定​单元格​平时​如何​显示​，​两者​可以​独立​配置​。

render_type ​显示​效果​ progressbar ​进度条​ button ​按钮​样式​ ​未​配置​或​未注册​ ​原有​ itemDelegate ​绘制

docs.title: 控制​渲染​高度
docs.text:
​进度条​和​按钮​都​支持​ max_height。​行高​超过​这个​值时​，​控件​高度​固定​为​ max_height ​并​在​单元格​内​ ​垂直​居中​；​行高较​小时​仍​跟随​单元格​可用​高度​。​该​参数​只​限制​渲染​控件​，​不​改变​行高​。

{
  "data_type": "float",
  "render_type": "progressbar",
  "max_height": 32
}

docs.title: 进度条
docs.text:
{
  "data_type": "float",
  "render_type": "progressbar",
  "min": 0,
  "max": 100,
  "suffix": "%",
  "max_height": 32,
  "show_percent_value": 0,
  "color": [[1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]]
}
  • min / max ​默认​是​ 0 / 100，​超出范围​会​按​边界​显示​。
  • suffix ​是​显示​值​的​后缀​，​例如​ %。
  • text_format ​可以​写成​ "{value:.1f}%" ​自定义​文字​。
  • show_text ​设​为​ false ​时​隐藏​数字​。
  • color ​支持​ [0, 1, 0] ​的​ 0～1 RGB ​或​ [0, 255, 0] ​的​ 0～255 RGB。
  • color ​写成​两个​颜色​时​，​第一个​颜色​对应​ 0%，​第二个​颜色​对应​ 100%，​中间​进度​按​ RGB/RGBA ​通道​线性插值​。​例如​ [[1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]] ​或​ ["#ff0000", "#00ff00"]。
  • show_percent_value ​只​影响​进度​文字​：​默认​ 0，​显示​数据​的​真实​值​；​设​为​ 1 ​时​， ​不管​ max ​是​多少​，​都​显示​按​ min / max ​换算​后​的​百分比​。
  • show_percent_value=1 ​时​如果​没有​显式​配置​ suffix，​百分比​默认​带​ %。

​进度条​只​绘制​绿色​完成​部分​，​未​填充​轨道​保持​透明​，​因此​会​使用​同一个​单元格​在​普通​、​选中​或​ ​鼠标​停留​状态​下​的​背景色​，​与​旁边​单元格​的​背景​保持一致​。color ​只​改变​完成​部分​的​颜色​。

​进度​文字​优先​使用​单元格​ ForegroundRole（role 9）​的​颜色​；​没有​设置​时​使用​视图​默认​文字​颜色​。 ​选中​或​鼠标​停留​不会​改变​进度​文字​颜色​。

docs.title: 按钮​样式
docs.text:
{
  "data_type": "list",
  "render_type": "button",
  "value_list": ["​待​审核​", "​已​通过​", "​返修​"]
}

​按钮​只​改变​显示​效果​，​单击​选中​、​双击​编辑​、​多行​输入​等​行为​与​普通​单元格​相同​。​按钮​也​支持​ color、suffix ​和​ text_format。

​按钮​会​优先​读取​单元格​自身​的​背景色​和​前景色​：

  • BackgroundRole（role 8）​作为​按钮​背景色​。
  • ForegroundRole（role 9）​作为​按钮​文字​色​。
  • button ​模式​不会​用​ role 8 ​铺满​整个​单元格​；​单元格​其余​区域​仍​显示​默认​底色​、 ​选中​或​鼠标悬停​背景​。
  • ​只​设置​了​背景色​时​，​会​自动​选择​黑色​或​白色​文字​保证​对比度​。
  • ​单元格​没有​背景色​时​，​可以​用​ app_args["color"] ​指定​默认​按钮​颜色​。

​例如​：

item.set_data({
    8: [0.2, 0.33, 0.67],  # ​按钮​背景​
    9: [1.0, 0.88, 0.4],   # ​按钮​文字​
})

docs.title: 扩展​新​显示方式
docs.text:
​给​开发者​：​显示​渲染器​位于​ xpm_extend.cell_renderers。​实现​ CellRenderer ​并​注册​即可​：

from Qt import QtCore, QtGui
from xpm_extend.cell_renderers import CellRenderer, register_cell_renderer


class TagRenderer(CellRenderer):
    render_type = "tag"

    def paint(self, view, painter, option, index, args):
        text = str(index.data(QtCore.Qt.DisplayRole))
        painter.fillRect(option.rect.adjusted(4, 4, -4, -4),
                         QtGui.QColor("#4488cc"))
        painter.setPen(QtGui.QColor("white"))
        painter.drawText(option.rect, QtCore.Qt.AlignCenter, text)


register_cell_renderer("tag", TagRenderer())

​列表​类型​示例​，choose items ​列​提供​ aaa、bbb、ccc：

​下​拉​列表​会​根据​最长​的​选项​文字​和​图标​自动​加宽​，​不会​为了​贴合​窄​单元格​而​把​内容​截成​省略号​：

  • ​短​选项​能够​完整​显示​时​，​下​拉​列表​与​单元格​同宽​，​不会​额外​超出​。
  • ​内容​较长​时​，​列表​从​单元格​左​边缘​向​右​扩展​，​左​边缘​和​图标​起始​位置​保持​对齐​。
  • ​列表​宽度​会​参考​当前​屏幕​的​可用​宽度​。​选项​特别​多时​仍​可​滚动​；​单个​选项​超过​屏幕​宽度​时​使用​横向​滚动​。

docs.title: 带​图标​的​字典​选项
docs.text:
value_list ​不​限于​字符串​。​每个​选项​可以​是​完整​的​ set_data ​字典​，​也​可以​把​显示​文字​和​ set_data ​数据​分开​写​。​选中​后​程序​会​对​每​一行​调用​ item.set_data()，​因此​角色​ 311 ​的​自定义​图标​绘制​、​显示​文字​、​颜色​等​设置​都​会​一起​生效​。

​直接​使用​ role ​字典​：

{
  "data_type": "list",
  "value_list": [
    {"0": "Circle", "311": [1, [[1, 0, 0], 20]]},
    {"0": "Blue square", "311": [0, [[0, 0, 1], 20, 20]]}
  ]
}

​也​可以​用​ label + data ​描述​：

{
  "label": "Circle",
  "data": {
    "0": "Circle",
    "311": [1, [[1, 0, 0], 20]]
  }
}

label ​是​下拉框​显示​的​文字​，data ​会​完整​传给​ item.set_data()。​没有​ label ​时​， ​会​尝试​使用​数据​里​的​ 0 ​角色​作为​显示​文字​。

Note

app_args ​同时​兼容​标准​ JSON ​和​ Python ​字典​字面​量​。​像​ {0: "​完成​", 311: [...]} ​这种​数字键​不​加​引号​的​写法​也​可以​直接​读取​。

docs.title: 配置​数据
docs.text:
​自定义​列​的​ app_args ​可以​写成​以下​形式​：

{
  "data_type": "list",
  "value_list": ["aaa", "bbb", "ccc"]
}

​数字​类型​还​可以​配置​可​选​参数​：

{
  "data_type": "float",
  "min": 0,
  "max": 100,
  "step": 0.1,
  "decimals": 2
}

​日期​和​时间​类型​可以​用​ display_format ​指定​控件​显示​格式​。

​选项​字典​中​的​ role ​编号​必须​能​转换成​整数​。​未​识别​的​ role ​会​保留​在​数据​中​，​由​现有​ item.set_data ​或​后续​插件​决定​如何​处理​。

docs.title: 扩展​新​类型
docs.text:
​给​开发者​：​表头​自​定义数据​可​通过​ hc.column_choose_menu.configer.datas['app_args'] ​读取​。​编辑器​注册表​和​输入​代理​分别​位于​ xpm_extend.cell_editor_types ​与​ xpm_extend.cell_editor_delegate。

​新增​类型​只​需​实现​一个​ EditorAdapter ​并​注册​：

from Qt import QtWidgets
from xpm_extend.cell_editor_types import EditorAdapter, register_editor_adapter


class ColorAdapter(EditorAdapter):
    data_type = "color"

    def create(self, parent, args, commit):
        return QtWidgets.QLineEdit(parent)

    def set_value(self, editor, value):
        editor.setText(str(value or ""))

    def value(self, editor):
        return editor.text()


register_editor_adapter("color", ColorAdapter())

​没有​注册​的​ data_type ​会​自动​回退​到​原有​ itemDelegate，​不会​影响​以前​的​自定义​输入​。

import os, shutil

def main(loader):
    row_objs = loader.selected()

    if not len(row_objs):
        return

    options = loader.QtWidgets.QFileDialog.Options()
    file_name, filtr = loader.QtWidgets.QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
        loader._container, "x", 'z', 
        "All Files (*);;ImageFiles (*.png)", "", options
    )

    if file_name == '':
        return

    for row_obj in row_objs:
        df = row_obj.datafile().data_file()
        dirname = os.path.dirname(df)
        icon_file = '%s/icon.png' % dirname
        shutil.copy2(file_name, icon_file)

docs.title: 根据​发布​时间​分组​自定义
docs.text:
​分组​的​原理​是​列​的​数据​相同​归为​一组​，​如果​要​根据​发布​时间​等​数据​分组​时​， ​时间​数据​是​精确​到​秒​的​，​这样​可能​是​每个​镜头​或者​资产​是​一组​，​并​没有​实现​分组​的​意义​，​假如​我们​希望​以​每天​或者​每月​分组​，​我们​需要​将​时间​数据​只​保留​到​天​或者​月​的​颗粒​度​即可​。

from PySide2 import QtCore

def main(item):
    # value = item.text()
    value = item.data(role=0)

    if value is None:
        return

    if isinstance(value, QtCore.QDateTime):
        date = value.date()
        return '%s/%s' % (date.year(), date.month())
    else:
        return value

Tip

​扩展​代码​如果​比较​长时​， ​建议​大部分​代码​在​独立​的​模块​文件​中​完成​， ​此处​只是​简单​的​代码​调用​、​参数​植入​等​， ​这​也​有利于​代码​重复使用​、​更​易​维护​。

docs.title: 表头​右键​菜单
docs.text:
​在​主视图​列​标题​上​点击​右键​，​可以​使用​：

  • ​将列​调整​为​合适​大小​：​只​调整​当​前列​。
  • ​将​所有​列​调整​为​合适​大小​：​重新​计算​全部列​宽​。
  • ​可​排序​：​打开​或​关闭​当前​视图​排序​，​设置​会​被​记住​。
  • ​隐藏​当​前列​：​把​当​前列​移出​显示​列表​。
  • ​显示​所有​隐藏​列​：​重新​显示​被​隐藏​的​列​。
  • ​列​：​展开​列​显示​/​隐藏​菜单​；​其​末尾​的​「​更​多​」​打开​完整​列​管理​窗口​。
  • ​复制​列​标识​：​复制​内部​列名​，​例如​ user_yxc____7。
  • ​添加​列​..：​输入​显示​名后​创建​自定义​列​，​内部​标识​自动​生成​。
  • ​编辑​列​..：​编辑​当​前列​的​名字​、​参数​和​ Python ​函数​。
  • ​表达式​..：​旧版​入口​，​当前​版本​只​读取​并​提示​表达式​，​没有​可靠​写回​配置​； ​新​配置​请​使用​ app_args ​或​ Python ​列​函数​。

Warning

「​隐藏​当​前列​」​只会​把​列​移出​当前​显示​列表​，​不​等于​删除​列​配置​。​需要​恢复​时​使用​ 「​列​」​菜单​或列​管理​窗口​重新​显示​。

docs.text:
​打开​ ​表头​右键​ → ​列​ → ​更​多​，​会​显示​列​管理​窗口​：

​区域​或​按钮​ ​作用​ ​显示​的​ ​当前​主视图​中​可见​的​列​，​顺序​就是​表格​中​的​顺序​ ​隐藏​的​ ​已​注册​但​没有​显示​的​列​ + ​新建​自定义​列​ > ​把​选中​的​显示​列移​到​隐藏​列表​ < ​把​选中​的​隐藏​列移​回​显示​列表​ ∧ / ∨ ​调整​选中​显示​列​的​先后顺序​ ​双击​列名​ ​打开​该列​的​详细​编辑​窗口​

​显示​状态​和​顺序​会​立即​保存​。​新​添加​的​列​通常​先​进入​隐藏​列表​，​需要​移​到​「​显示​的​」​后​才​会​出现​在​主视图​。

docs.title: 详细​编辑​字​段
docs.text:
​详细​编辑​窗口​来自​ menuedit ​配置​，​当前​字​段​如下​：

​界面​字​段​ ​配置​键​ ​用途​ ​名字​ labels ​表头​显示​文字​，​可以​随时​改名​，​不​影响​内部​列​标识​ sign ​表头​ real_label ​内部​列​标识​，​只读​；​脚本​和​ app_args ​使用​这个​值​作为​键​ ​参数​ app_args ​单元格​输入​参数​，​保存​为​字符串​ apps app_type ​可选​的​用途​说明​或​应用​标识​字符串​ Python python_command ​根据​当前​行​计算​列值​的​ Python ​函数​

Note

​当前​表头​代码​不会​仅凭​ apps ​字​段​自动​过滤​ DCC。​列​是否​显示​由列​管理​中​的​显示​/​隐藏​状态​决定​； apps ​供​插件​或​项目​脚本​按​需​解释​。

​点击​ OK ​后​只​保存​当​前列​；​点击​ Cancel ​放弃​本次​修改​。

docs.title: 单元格​参数​ app_args
docs.text:
app_args ​决定​双击​单元格​时​使用​什么​输入​控件​。​详细​格式​和​示例​见​ ​自定义​单元格​输入​。

​同一个​ app_args ​还​可以​用​ render_type ​指定​平时​的​显示方式​：

render_type ​显示方式​ progressbar ​进度条​ button ​按钮​样式​

​编辑​控件​和​显示方式​分开​配置​。​例如​：

{
  "data_type": "float",
  "render_type": "progressbar"
}

​行高较​高时​可以​用​ max_height ​限制​进度条​或​按钮​的​最大​显示​高度​，​控件​会​在​单元格​内​垂直​居中​。

button ​会​读取​单元格​ role 8 ​的​背景色​作为​按钮​底色​，​读取​ role 9 ​的​前景色​作为​文字​色​； ​未​设置​文字​色​时会​自动​选择​高对比度​颜色​。

​目前​内置​类型​包括​：

data_type ​输入​方式​ list ​下​拉​选择​，value_list ​提供​选项​ float / double ​浮点数​输入框​ int / integer ​整数​输入框​ datetime ​日期​时间​输入​ date ​日期​输入​ time ​时间​输入​

​没有​配置​或​没有​注册​的​类型​会​继续​使用​原来​的​ itemDelegate。

app_args ​字​段​同时​接受​标准​ JSON ​和​ Python ​字典​字面​量​。​下​拉​选项​可以​直接​携带​ role ​数据​：

{
    "data_type": "list",
    "value_list": [
        {0: "​完成​", 311: [1, [[0.5, 1, 0.5], 20]]},
        {0: "​等待​", 311: [1, [[0.5, 1, 1], 20]]},
    ],
}

​其中​：

  • 0 ​是​单元格​显示​文字​。
  • 311 ​是​ XP ​现有​的​自定义​图标​绘制​角色​。
  • ​字典​会​完整​交给​ item.set_data()，​所以​图标​、​颜色​等​角色​可以​一起​生效​。

docs.title: Python ​计算​列
docs.text:
Python ​字段​中​的​函数​必须​使用​ main(row) ​形式​，​并​返回​该​单元格​要​显示​的​值​：

def main(row):
    return row.item("root").text().split("_")[0]

​上面​的​函数​从​名称​中取​场次​。​也​可以​读取​同一​行​的​其他​列​：

def main(row):
    return "_".join(row.item("root").text().split("_")[:2])

​保存​后​会​重新​编译​列​函数​并​刷新​相关​列​。​带​ Python ​函数​的​自定义​列​属于​计算​列​，​不​按​普通​可​编辑​列​ ​写回​单元格​数据​；​需要​人工​输入​的​值应​放在​普通​的​自定义​列​并​通过​ app_args ​配置​输入​控件​。

docs.title: 配置文件
docs.text:
​列​配置​按​用户​、​按​视图​分别​保存​，​路径​模式​为​：

<​项目​根目录​>/prefs/<​视图​>/<​用户名​>__column.json

​当前​ xp_demo ​的​ shot ​视图​示例​：

D:/share/apps/xp/1.3.2.0/project/xp_demo/prefs/shot/user_yxc__column.json

​主要​结构​：

{
  "items": ["root", "icon", "name", "user_yxc____7"],
  "labels": {
    "user_yxc____7": "​解算​状态​"
  },
  "app_args": {
    "user_yxc____7": "{\"data_type\": \"list\", \"value_list\": [...]}"
  },
  "app_type": {},
  "python_command": {},
  "modify_user": {},
  "modify_time": {}
}

​说明​：

  • items ​决定​当前​视图​显示​哪些​列​以及​顺序​。
  • labels ​保存​显示​名​。
  • app_args ​的​值​是​字符串​，​不是​直接​嵌​在​配置​里​的​对象​。
  • python_command ​保存​ Python ​函数​源码​。
  • modify_user / modify_time ​记录​各列​最后​修改​信息​。

Warning

​优先​通过​界面​修改​配置​。​程序运行​时以​内存​配置​为准​，​直接​改​文件​后​如果​没有​重新​加载​， ​可能​被​下​一次​保存​覆盖​；​手工​修改​前应​先​关闭​对应​视图​或​备份​配置文件​。

docs.title: 相关​脚本​接口
docs.text:
loader = xm.views.shot.loader()
config = loader.user_config

config.datas["labels"]["user_yxc____7"] = "​解算​状态​"
config.datas["app_args"]["user_yxc____7"] = app_args_text
config.datas["python_command"]["user_yxc____7"] = python_func_text
config.save_datas("user_yxc____7")

save_datas(column_name) ​只​保存​指定​列​相关​数据​；save() ​保存​当前​用户​配置​的​全部列​数据​。

docs.title: 概述
docs.text:
​程序​自带​多套​深色​配色​，​可以​按​个人​习惯​或者​制作​环境​选择​：​做​灯光​、​合成​时​习惯​深底​的​用​ dark， ​想要​对比​柔和​一点​的​用​ gray，​习惯​ Maya ​界面​的​可以​直接​选​ maya（​这套​是​按​ Autodesk Maya ​的​界面​配色​取样​的​）。

​主题​只​改变​外观​，​不会​改动​项目​数据​，​也​不​影响​正在​运行​的​任务​。

  • ​选择​会​被​记住​，​下次​启动​自动​恢复​上次​用​的​配色​
  • ​想​回到​出厂​状态​，​在​菜单​里​选​「​还原​默认​外观​」​即可​

docs.title: 快速​切换​（​标题栏​按钮​）
docs.text:
​标题栏​「​最小化​」​左边​有​一颗​「​左深​右​浅​」​的​圆形​按钮​，​点​一下​就​能​在​ ​默认​亮色​ ​和​ ​上次​使用​的​深色​配色​ ​之间​来回​切换​，​不用​打开​菜单​（​没切​过​深色​时​，​第一次​会​套用​ Maya ​配色​）。

​上图​从​右​往​左​依次​是​：​关闭​、​最大化​、​最小化​、​主题​切换​按钮​，​最​左边​是​当前​账户​。

​在​ Maya、Nuke ​等​宿主​里​没有​这套​标题栏​，​按钮​会​自动隐藏​，​用​下面​的​菜单​切换​。

docs.title: 选择​具体​配色
docs.text:
​打开​ ​工具​ → ​主题​配色​，​选择​需要​的​配色​：

​配色​ ​说明​ dark ​深色​，​对比​最强​ gray ​灰调​，​对比​柔和​ maya ​按​ Maya ​界面​配色​取样​，​习惯​ Maya ​的​可以​直接​用​ maya_light ​按​ Maya ​的​层次​关系​推导​的​浅色​版​；​当前​版本​没有​随包​提供​该​配色​资源​时会​显示​为​**​灰色​不可​选​** ​还原​默认​外观​ ​回到​出厂​的​亮色​外观

docs.title: 实际效果
docs.text: ​深色​主题​下​的​主​界面​（​菜单​、​工具栏​、​表格​、​状态栏​一起​变​）：

docs.title: 切换​主题​会​一起​处理​哪些地方
docs.text:
• ​主​窗口​、​菜单​、​工具栏​、​状态栏​
  • ​表格​、​树​、​列表​和​表头​
  • ​脚本​编辑器​里​的​语法​配色​（​深色​底会​自动​换成​看得清​的​一套​；​换回​亮色​会​恢复程序​原本​的​配色​）
  • ​数据​可视化​里​的​图表​
  • ​标题栏​的​最小化​ / ​最大化​ / ​关闭​按钮​

​数据​可视化​模块​是​按​需​加载​的​：​切换​主题​时​如果​图表​还​没​打开​，​之后​打开​会​自动​套用​当前​主题​， ​不​需要​再切​一次​。

​给​开发者​：​配色​来自​插件​ xpm_extend.theme，​脚本​里​也​能​直接​调用​。

from xpm_extend.theme import dark_codex_theme as t

t.apply("maya", xm)     # ​套用​配色​（​外观​ + ​图表​ + ​脚本​编辑器​ + ​标题栏​按钮​）
t.revert()              # ​还原成​程序​默认​外观​

docs.text:

docs.title: 添加​自定义​列
docs.text:
​添加​自定义​列​， ​可​用于​显示​自​定义数据​，​自​定义数据​可以​是​用户​输入​、​也​可​通过​python​命令​展示​程序​返回​的​数据​、​也​可是​镜头​组装​时​的​配置​参数​，​便于​集中统一​设置​。

​在​表​头上​右键​菜单​点击​>​列​>​更​多​ ​打开​ ​列​管理​

  • ​点击​ ​加号​添加​， ​输入​标签​名​（​显示​的​名字​）, ​点击​OK​创建​.

  • ​双击​可​编辑​当​前列​
  • python​栏可​输入​python​代码​获取​想要​展示​的​数据​ ​添加​自定义​列​, ​显示​特定​数据​

docs.text:
X-pipeline ​是​一款​用于​三维动画​、CG​电影​及​视觉​特效​项目​的​轻量级​生产​流水线​软件​。

docs.title: 2. ​组装​下游​文件
docs.text:
​桌面​端​流程​管理​主程序​， ​主要​用于​批量​化​管理​资产​、​镜头​、​上下游​文件​等​。​镜头​文件​组装​ ​是​主要​的​核心​功能​，​通常​上下游​环节​文件​交互​如果​没有​批量​集成化​的​工具​，​需要​制作人员​很多​手动​导入​、​导出​、​合并​文件​等​操作​，​费事​费力​、​且​容易​出错​，​流程​管理​ ​就是​为了​解决​这​类​问题​，​它​将​繁琐​、​容易​出错​的​操作​通过​命令​工具化​实现​、​并​可以​集中​、​批量​化​处理​文件​。

​其他​频繁​手动​、​机械化​的​操作​也​很​容易​通过​自定义​的​方式​集成​进来​。

​镜头​组装​主要​实现​了​以下​自动化​:

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The "Local Control Channel" is a small service the application opens on this machine only: external scripts (command line, another Python process, automation tools) can use it to read the application state, take screenshots, and — when explicitly allowed — execute code and operate the interface.

It serves two main purposes:

  • On-site troubleshooting: when an issue only reproduces on a specific machine, support can read the real state inside the application instead of asking for screenshots and log exports
  • Batch work and automation: apply the same operation to many machines, or connect the application to an existing automation flow

Off by default, and only visible to administrators

The channel is off by default and must be enabled manually after each start. Its menu entry is only shown to accounts with administrator or higher permission (see Pipeline Management - Account Permissions).

docs.title: Enabling and Disabling
docs.text:
Open ​工具​ (Tools) → ​本​机​控制​通道​ (Local Control Channel):

Menu item Description ​启用​ (Enable) Checked means running, unchecked means stopped; the check mark always matches the real state ​允许​执行​代码​（exec） Off by default. Allows executing arbitrary code remotely; changing it requires stopping and re-enabling the channel to take effect ​显示​连接​信息​… Shows the address, token, current state, and the paths of the config file and audit log; the text can be selected and copied

docs.title: Status Bar Indicator
docs.text:
While the channel is running, an indicator appears on the right side of the status bar:

State Indicator Running Amber ● ​桥接​已​开启​ Running with code execution allowed Red ● ​桥接​已​开启​ · ​可​执行​代码​

The indicator sits to the right of the account label; click it to see the connection info:

It re-checks the real state every 3 seconds: it disappears by itself if the channel is stopped or crashes, and it is not shown at all while the channel is off — the status bar never claims the channel is running when it is not.

docs.title: Connection Info
docs.text:
"​显示​连接​信息​…" shows the current address and token, plus the location of two files:

Content Location Config file (token, port, on/off state) %APPDATA%\XpApps\bridge.json Audit log bridge_audit.log in the temp directory (the full path is shown in the dialog)

Example call from outside (one JSON object per line, framed by \n):

import json
import socket


def call(action, payload=None, port=8765, token="<token from the info dialog>"):
    with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=20) as s:
        req = {"id": 1, "action": action, "payload": payload or {}, "token": token}
        s.sendall((json.dumps(req, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))
        buf = b""
        while not buf.endswith(b"\n"):      # screenshots are large, read until the newline
            chunk = s.recv(65536)
            if not chunk:
                break
            buf += chunk
    return json.loads(buf.decode("utf-8"))


print(call("status"))                       # window title / size / visibility
print(call("screenshot"))                   # main window screenshot (base64 PNG)
print(call("exec", {"code": "result = 1 + 1"}))
Action Payload Description ping — Returns pong; use it to check the channel status — Window title, size, visibility, minimized state screenshot — Main window screenshot (base64 PNG) exec {"code": "..."} Run Python code and return its output; requires code execution to be allowed click {"name": "widget"} Click a widget by name set_text {"name": "...", "text": "..."} Set a widget's text

docs.title: Security Notes
docs.text:
• It only binds to the loopback address 127.0.0.1, so other machines cannot connect; other programs on the same machine can
  • The token is generated randomly the first time you enable the channel and stored in the user directory (%APPDATA%\XpApps\bridge.json), readable only by the current user; requests with a wrong token are rejected outright
  • "Allow code execution (exec)" is equivalent to handing over everything the application can do — enable it only when needed and turn it off afterwards, do not leave it on permanently
  • Every call leaves a record in the audit log (time, action, success/failure, first 120 characters of executed code)
  • The menu entry is only shown to administrators; regular artists cannot see it
  • If the feature is not needed, a release build can be shipped without loading it at all

docs.title: FAQ
docs.text:
"Bridge ​启动​失败​（​端口​ 8765 ​可能​被​占用​）" is shown

The port is already used by another program. Use a different port, or close the program holding the port and try again.

Does the channel stay after closing the application?

No. It ends together with the application; you need to enable it manually again next time.

How do I get a new token?

Delete %APPDATA%\XpApps\bridge.json; a new token is generated the next time you enable the channel.

Why can't I see the "Local Control Channel" menu?

It is only shown to administrator accounts and above. See Pipeline Management - Account Permissions.

docs.title: Cell Rendering render_type
docs.text:
data_type selects the editor opened on double-click, while render_type controls how the cell is displayed at rest. They are configured independently.

render_type Rendering progressbar Progress bar button Button style Missing or unregistered Original itemDelegate painting

docs.title: Limit Render Height
docs.text:
Both progress bars and buttons support max_height. When the row is taller, the rendered control is capped at max_height and vertically centered. Shorter rows continue to use the available cell height. The parameter affects only the rendered control; it does not change the row height.

{
  "data_type": "float",
  "render_type": "progressbar",
  "max_height": 32
}

docs.title: Progress Bar
docs.text:
{
  "data_type": "float",
  "render_type": "progressbar",
  "min": 0,
  "max": 100,
  "suffix": "%",
  "max_height": 32,
  "show_percent_value": 0,
  "color": [[1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]]
}
  • min / max default to 0 / 100; values are clamped to that range.
  • suffix is appended to the displayed value.
  • text_format can be a format string such as "{value:.1f}%".
  • Set show_text to false to hide the value.
  • color accepts 0–1 RGB such as [0, 1, 0] or 0–255 RGB such as [0, 255, 0].
  • When color contains two colors, the first is used at 0% and the second at 100%. Intermediate progress is linearly interpolated across RGB/RGBA channels, for example [[1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]] or ["#ff0000", "#00ff00"].
  • show_percent_value affects the progress text only. The default is 0, which shows the real data value. Set it to 1 to show the percentage calculated from min / max, regardless of max.
  • When show_percent_value=1, the default percentage suffix is % unless suffix is explicitly set.

The progress bar draws only the filled portion; the unfilled track is transparent. It therefore matches the same cell's normal, selected, or hovered background and stays consistent with neighboring cells. color changes only the filled portion.

Progress text uses the cell's ForegroundRole (role 9) when available, otherwise the view's default text color. Selection and hover do not change the progress text color.

docs.title: Button Style
docs.text:
{
  "data_type": "list",
  "render_type": "button",
  "value_list": ["Pending", "Approved", "Rework"]
}

The button only changes the appearance. Selection, double-click editing, and multi-row editing behave exactly like a normal cell. It also supports color, suffix, and text_format.

The button reads colors from the cell first:

  • BackgroundRole (role 8) becomes the button background.
  • ForegroundRole (role 9) becomes the button text color.
  • In button mode, role 8 is not painted across the entire cell. The rest of the cell keeps its default, selected, or hovered background.
  • If only a background is set, black or white text is chosen automatically for contrast.
  • If the cell has no background, app_args["color"] can provide a default button color.

For example:

item.set_data({
    8: [0.2, 0.33, 0.67],  # button background
    9: [1.0, 0.88, 0.4],   # button text
})

docs.title: Add a New Renderer
docs.text:
For developers: renderers live in xpm_extend.cell_renderers. Implement and register a CellRenderer:

from Qt import QtCore, QtGui
from xpm_extend.cell_renderers import CellRenderer, register_cell_renderer


class TagRenderer(CellRenderer):
    render_type = "tag"

    def paint(self, view, painter, option, index, args):
        text = str(index.data(QtCore.Qt.DisplayRole))
        painter.fillRect(option.rect.adjusted(4, 4, -4, -4),
                         QtGui.QColor("#4488cc"))
        painter.setPen(QtGui.QColor("white"))
        painter.drawText(option.rect, QtCore.Qt.AlignCenter, text)


register_cell_renderer("tag", TagRenderer())

In this example, the choose items column offers aaa, bbb, and ccc:

The drop-down automatically expands to fit the longest option text and icon instead of eliding content to match a narrow cell:

  • When the options fit, the popup has exactly the same width as the cell and does not overhang it.
  • When content is longer, the popup expands to the right from the cell's left edge. The popup and icon column stay aligned with the cell start.
  • Its width is limited by the available screen width. Long option lists remain scrollable; an individual option wider than the screen uses a horizontal scrollbar.

docs.title: Dictionary Options with Icons
docs.text:
value_list is not limited to strings. Each option can be a complete set_data dictionary, or it can separate the label from the data. On commit, the editor calls item.set_data() for each target row, so custom icon painting through role 311, display text, colors, and other roles are applied together.

A direct role dictionary:

{
  "data_type": "list",
  "value_list": [
    {"0": "Circle", "311": [1, [[1, 0, 0], 20]]},
    {"0": "Blue square", "311": [0, [[0, 0, 1], 20, 20]]}
  ]
}

The label + data form is also supported:

{
  "label": "Circle",
  "data": {
    "0": "Circle",
    "311": [1, [[1, 0, 0], 20]]
  }
}

label is shown in the drop-down, while data is passed unchanged to item.set_data(). If label is omitted, role 0 inside the data is used as the display text.

Note

app_args accepts both standard JSON and Python dictionary literals. Forms such as {0: "Done", 311: [...]} with unquoted numeric keys are also supported.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
The custom column's app_args can contain:

{
  "data_type": "list",
  "value_list": ["aaa", "bbb", "ccc"]
}

Numeric types also accept optional settings:

{
  "data_type": "float",
  "min": 0,
  "max": 100,
  "step": 0.1,
  "decimals": 2
}

Date and time types can use display_format to set the control's display format.

Role keys in an option dictionary must be convertible to integers. Unrecognized roles remain in the data for the existing item.set_data implementation or another plugin to handle.

docs.title: Add a New Type
docs.text:
For developers: the header metadata is available through hc.column_choose_menu.configer.datas['app_args']. The editor registry and input proxy live in xpm_extend.cell_editor_types and xpm_extend.cell_editor_delegate.

Implement and register an EditorAdapter to add a type:

from Qt import QtWidgets
from xpm_extend.cell_editor_types import EditorAdapter, register_editor_adapter


class ColorAdapter(EditorAdapter):
    data_type = "color"

    def create(self, parent, args, commit):
        return QtWidgets.QLineEdit(parent)

    def set_value(self, editor, value):
        editor.setText(str(value or ""))

    def value(self, editor):
        return editor.text()


register_editor_adapter("color", ColorAdapter())

docs.title: Custom grouping by publish time
docs.text:
The principle of grouping is that rows with the same column data are grouped together. If grouping by data such as publish time, the time data is accurate to the second, which may result in each shot or asset being its own group, defeating the purpose of grouping. If we want to group by day or month, we just need to keep the time data at the granularity of day or month.

from PySide2 import QtCore

def main(item):
    # value = item.text()
    value = item.data(role=0)

    if value is None:
        return

    if isinstance(value, QtCore.QDateTime):
        date = value.date()
        return '%s/%s' % (date.year(), date.month())
    else:
        return value

Tip

When the extension code is relatively long, it is recommended to complete most of the code in a separate module file. Here it is just simple code calls, parameter insertion, etc., which is also conducive to code reuse and easier maintenance.

docs.title: Header Column Configuration
docs.text: The main view supports showing, hiding, reordering, and adding custom columns, as well as configuring column labels, cell arguments, and Python-computed values. Header actions are subject to the current account's user_level permission.

docs.title: Header Context Menu
docs.text:
Right-click a column header to access:

  • Resize Column to Contents: resize only the current column.
  • Resize All Columns to Contents: recalculate every column width.
  • Sortable: enable or disable sorting for the current view; the setting is remembered.
  • Hide Current Column: remove the current column from the visible list.
  • Show All Hidden Columns: restore every hidden column.
  • Columns: expand the visibility menu; More at the end opens the full column manager.
  • Copy Column Identifier: copy the internal column key, such as user_yxc____7.
  • Add Column...: enter a display label and create a custom column with an automatic internal key.
  • Edit Column...: edit the current column's label, arguments, and Python function.
  • Expression...: legacy entry point. The current implementation only loads and prompts for the expression and does not reliably write it back; use app_args or a Python column function instead.

Warning

Hide Current Column only removes a column from the visible set. It does not delete the column configuration. Restore it from the Columns menu or the column manager.

docs.title: Column Manager
docs.text:
Open Header context menu → Columns → More:

Area or button Purpose Visible (​显示​的​) Columns currently shown in the main view, in table order Hidden (​隐藏​的​) Registered columns that are not currently shown + Create a custom column > Move selected visible columns to the hidden list < Move selected hidden columns back to the visible list ∧ / ∨ Reorder the selected visible column Double-click Open the detailed editor for that column

Visibility and order are saved immediately. A newly created column usually starts in the hidden list and must be moved to the visible list before it appears in the main view.

docs.title: Detailed Editor Fields
docs.text:
UI field Config key Purpose ​名字​ (Label) labels Header display text; changing it does not change the internal column key sign header real_label Read-only internal key used by scripts and app_args ​参数​ (Arguments) app_args String containing cell input settings apps app_type Optional usage/application identifier string Python python_command Python function that computes the column value for each row

Note

The current header implementation does not automatically filter columns by apps. Visibility is determined by the column manager; plugins and project scripts may interpret app_type themselves.

OK saves only the current column. Cancel discards the edit.

docs.title: Cell Arguments app_args
docs.text:
app_args selects the cell editor used when a cell is opened. Full formats and examples are in Custom Cell Input.

The same app_args can use render_type to control how the cell is displayed:

render_type Rendering progressbar Progress bar button Button style

Editing and rendering are configured independently:

{
  "data_type": "float",
  "render_type": "progressbar"
}

Use max_height to limit the displayed height of a progress bar or button in taller rows; the control is vertically centered within the cell.

For button, the cell's role 8 background becomes the button fill color and role 9 foreground becomes the text color. If no foreground is set, a high-contrast text color is selected automatically.

Built-in types:

data_type Input list Drop-down using value_list float / double Floating-point spin box int / integer Integer spin box datetime Date-time input date Date input time Time input

Unconfigured or unregistered types fall back to the original itemDelegate.

app_args accepts both standard JSON and Python dictionary literals. List options can carry full role data:

{
    "data_type": "list",
    "value_list": [
        {0: "Done", 311: [1, [[0.5, 1, 0.5], 20]]},
        {0: "Waiting", 311: [1, [[0.5, 1, 1], 20]]},
    ],
}
  • 0 is the displayed cell text.
  • 311 is XP's existing custom icon-paint role.
  • The dictionary is passed to item.set_data(), so icon, color, and other roles apply together.

docs.title: Python-Computed Columns
docs.text:
The Python field must define main(row) and return the value to display:

def main(row):
    return row.item("root").text().split("_")[0]

The function above extracts a sequence from the name. It can also read other cells in the same row:

def main(row):
    return "_".join(row.item("root").text().split("_")[:2])

After saving, the column functions are recompiled and the related columns refresh. A custom column with a Python function is treated as a computed column and is not written back as a normal editable cell. Put manually entered values in a regular custom column and configure its cell editor through app_args.

docs.title: Configuration File
docs.text:
Column configuration is stored per user and per view:

<project root>/prefs/<view>/<username>__column.json

Example for the xp_demo shot view:

D:/share/apps/xp/1.3.2.0/project/xp_demo/prefs/shot/user_yxc__column.json

Main structure:

{
  "items": ["root", "icon", "name", "user_yxc____7"],
  "labels": {
    "user_yxc____7": "Solve Status"
  },
  "app_args": {
    "user_yxc____7": "{\"data_type\": \"list\", \"value_list\": [...]}"
  },
  "app_type": {},
  "python_command": {},
  "modify_user": {},
  "modify_time": {}
}
  • items controls which columns are visible and their order.
  • labels stores display labels.
  • Each app_args value is a string, not a directly embedded object.
  • python_command stores Python function source.
  • modify_user / modify_time record the last edit metadata for each column.

Warning

Prefer the UI. The running application uses its in-memory configuration; direct file edits may be overwritten by the next save unless the view is reloaded. Back up the file before editing it manually.

The application ships with several dark color schemes, so you can pick what suits your habit or your working environment: use dark for a high-contrast dark look, gray for a softer contrast, or maya if you are used to the Autodesk Maya interface (it is sampled from Maya's actual UI colors).

docs.text:
To the left of "Minimize" in the title bar there is a round "half dark, half light" button. Click it to switch between the default light appearance and the last dark scheme you used, without opening any menu (the first time, it applies the Maya scheme).

From right to left: Close, Maximize, Minimize, the theme toggle button, and the current account.

Inside host applications such as Maya or Nuke there is no such title bar, so the button is hidden automatically — use the menu below instead.

Scheme Description dark Dark, strongest contrast gray Gray tones, softer contrast maya Sampled from the Maya interface; handy if you are used to Maya maya_light Light version derived from Maya's layering; it appears grayed out when the color resources are not shipped with the current build ​还原​默认​外观​ Restore the factory light appearance

docs.title: What the Theme Covers
docs.text:
• Main window, menus, toolbars and the status bar
  • Tables, trees, lists and their headers
  • Syntax colors in the script editor (dark backgrounds get a readable set; switching back to light restores the original colors)
  • Charts in the data visualization module
  • The Minimize / Maximize / Close buttons in the title bar

The data visualization module loads on demand: if the charts are not open yet when you switch themes, they will pick up the current theme when you open them later — no need to switch again.

For developers: the color schemes live in the xpm_extend.theme plugin and can also be driven from the script editor.

from xpm_extend.theme import dark_codex_theme as t
